data.one_liner: Advanced Dio interceptor that adds flexible caching, expiry and deduplication.
data.what_it_does: Provides per‑request control over caching, conditional rules, absolute or relative expiry, and request deduplication for Dio HTTP calls. Stores cached responses persistently using Hive and adds standard Cache‑Status headers.
use_when: You need fine‑grained caching for Dio requests
You want automatic cache expiry and deduplication
avoid_when: You are not using Dio as your HTTP client
You need a lightweight solution without persistent storage
strengths: Supports both duration and absolute expiry
weaknesses: Adds complexity compared to plain Dio
Relies on Hive which may increase app size
Only works with Dio, not other HTTP clients

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler setup if you don't need caching features

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight HTTP client without caching overhead
